notes.title: Version 1.0.0#175 update log

tags.bug: *.Optimization of archive write mechanism to avoid bad files and black screen issues caused by write interruptions;
*.When there are 'Crimson Rain' on the heart card, taking [Caged Nourishment] will not deduct the maximum life limit;
*.When there are "Crimson Rain" on the heart card, the "Movement Curse II" will not deduct the maximum life limit;
*.When there are "Crimson Rain" on the heart card, the invincible effect does not take effect;
*.The problem of bullets not being fired simultaneously when using a "War Axe" for attack;
*.The problem of the enemy's 'Expanding Wormhole' effect not taking effect when there is only one Enemy;
*.The problem of not being able to replace DIY skins for 6 mystery cards, including[Mirrored Moon][Antlers In Cup][Flesh On Plate][Your Shadow][Spectral Stranger][Blazing Phantom];

*.The problem with the overflow damage of the "Skeleton Key" that has been increased in points and attached with a puncture cannot trigger the "Necro Touch" to eliminate the target when the puncture reaches the over enemy.
